name: llmfit
description: Hundreds of models & providers. One command to find what runs on your hardware.
one_liner: A terminal tool that looks at your computer's specs and tells you which AI models will actually run well on it, instead of you guessing and hitting out-of-memory errors.
buyer: A hobbyist or small-business owner buying a new PC specifically to run local AI models, who doesn't want to waste money on hardware that can't run the models they need.
business_use_cases: A computer retailer or system integrator uses it (or its API) to recommend and configure 'AI-ready' PC builds for customers.
A local-AI hosting reseller uses the benchmark data to publish 'which laptop should I buy for local AI' comparison content that drives affiliate sales.
An MSP consulting on-prem AI deployments for small businesses uses it to right-size hardware purchases before recommending a rollout.

money_ideas.idea: License the hardware-compatibility engine via the REST API to hardware retailers as a 'will it run' widget on product pages.
Sell a 'build recommendation' report generator for people shopping for an AI workstation.

steal_this: Wrap the REST API into a simple 'Will This Laptop Run AI?' web widget and pitch it to a PC-building YouTuber or retailer this weekend.
